profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amentum (formerly Jacobs CMS)
profile.summary: Hi! I'm a software engineer who loves building user-centric applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fullstack Senior Software Engineer

•	Mentoring a team of four other software engineers to visualize global threats and generate $12 million in contract revenue
•	Architecting and developing software for nuclear command and control systems using React, Redux and Typescript 
•	Adding custom WebGL scenes and objects to improve 3D Globe performance by 500%.
•	Creating three new microservices with Express.js, PostgreSQL, WebSocket, React and Typecript
•	Developing GitLab and Bamboo pipelines for building and testing microservices within an air-gapped environment
•	Writing tests with Jest and Vitest to maintain 80%+ code coverage across all microservices 
•	Leading client-facing architecture presentations and answering design questions from the customer
•	Translated 155 obscure requirements to 272 actionable tickets and enforced modern agile practices
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Industry · TypeScript · React.js · Node.js · Express.js · System Architecture · DevOps · Atlassian Bamboo · Atlassian Suite

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fullstack Software Engineer
•	Developing new features, components and libraries with Typescript and React that generated $8 million in revenue
•	Interacting with 22 different APIs using Java to send and receive satellite data
•	Building new APIs in ExpressJS to expose software functionality to other teams
•	Creating a full-stack application to help train satellite operators on simulated hardware
•	Writing automated testing libraries in Javascript and Cypress
•	Constructed and maintained Bamboo pipelines to test and build binaries and push them to Artifactory
 

Software Engineer
•	Created a GUI via C#, WPF and SCPI commands that tests and controls fiber optic systems
•	Executed data analysis to monitor fiber optic mirror alignment for $600k of customer’s equipment 

Lead DevOps Engineer
•	Primary CI/CD pipeline developer integrating DevOps tools via Groovy and batch scripts
•	Automated agile team’s build, test, and deployment processes to speed up the development and testing of software releases
•	Saved the company ~$300k in engineering hours via my DevOps pipelines
•	Created generic features to help other teams adopt DevOps pipelines which helped save another ~$200k
•	Developed Python test suites using TestComplete to automate functional acceptance test procedures
•	Lead and participated in sprint planning, retrospectives, story pointing, and backlog grooming in a team of 7 engineers

positions.title: Undergraduate Course Assistant
positions.description:
•	Wrote C# scripts in Unity to streamline the Digital Arts and Sciences Game Development curriculum
•	Helped class of 57 students learn how to apply software concepts and how to debug their code
•	Collaborated with professor to construct sample games and environments using C# and Unity

company.name: University of Florida - Digital Arts and Sciences

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed proof of concepts and minimum viable products (MVPs) for startups in Gainesville and Miami
•	Created 3D, interactive learning system using Unity and C# to demonstrate client’s learning system to investors
•	Curated interactive experiences between educators and children using Python and dynamic text-to-speech libraries

company.name: University of Florida - Computer & Information Science & Engineering

positions.title: Software Private Tutor
positions.description:
•	Worked one-on-one with students seeking to learn more about programming
•	Developed and implemented detailed lesson plans specifically catered to each students’ needs.
•	Learned React to diversify the subjects I could teach to students
•	Tutored 16+ students in Java, data structures, VR, Unity and more

positions.title: App Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed client-side logic that displayed hiking and camping suggestions based on location and preferences
•	Debugged features in legacy Typescript code to restore app functionality
•	Created cloud-based Firebase triggers to push notifications to users
•	Implemented Google Analytics to track user actions and activity while using the app

positions.title: Vice President of Internal Affairs
positions.description:
•	Instantiating WECE’s first design teams building a 700mA solar panel charger and a Raspberry Pi face/color detection robot
•	Designing boot camps and workshops that teach students how to think and create critically

company.name: University of Florida's Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering

positions.title: Live Streamer and Producer
positions.description: •	Broadcasting a program I produce called Friday Night Hacks, where I teach complex coding questions to my viewers

positions.title: Engineering Startup Intern
positions.description:
•	Created an inventory system with PHP and hosted locally on a Raspberry Pi 3.0
•	Built an interactive learning system using Javascript, CSS and HTML to onboard 15 incoming interns on best practices

positions.title: VP Technology
positions.description:
•	Delegating leadership roles to qualified individuals
•	Budgeting the time and money required for each project
•	Coordinating with other SHPE e-board members to maximize publicity and efficiency for SHPE projects
•	Increased membership and participation in SHPE to 280 active members
•	Managing and spearheading 3D Printer, 3D Scanner, and EMG design teams
•	Vastly expanded size and scope of tech cabinet by quadrupling number of open positions
•	Creating workshops to educate SHPE members in C++, Arduino, and Solidworks

positions.title: Liason
positions.description:
•	Orchestrating coordination with other technical engineering organizations for joint workshops and projects
•	Securing WECE’s budget and its place in UF through the Benton Engineering Counsel (BEC)
•	Creating benchmarks for success to imperially measure how well events go

positions.title: Director of Electrical/Controls
positions.description:
•	Leading a group of students and motivating them to successfully create a submarine that runs with clean energy at low cost
•	Proactively self-teaching C++ and circuits design to use on the project
•	Delegating tasks and responsibilities based on team players’ strengths

volunteerExperiences.description: I coordinate and put together different technical workshops to teach UF Undergraduates different technical skills such as SolidWorks, Arduino software and hardware, and C++. As VP Tech for SHPE, my goal is to give back to the University of Florida community by providing these free lessons.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering
volunteerExperiences.description: I regularly volunteer at the Cade to teach children advanced, complex science topics and to foster a passion for STEM. In this capacity, I spark a curiosity for STEM-related fields in hopes that these young impressionable minds will become engineers themselves.

company.name: Women in Electrical and Computer Engineering
